ipos.name: Green Asia Impex
ipos.about: Green Asia Impex operates as an integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities, catering primarily to business-to-business customers, including importers, distributors, and food processing companies in domestic and international markets. The company operates in two main business segments: shrimps and dried chillies. In the shrimp segment, the company sources raw shrimps from local aquaculture farmers and traders, processes them through grading, peeling, deveining, and freezing, and supplies processed frozen shrimp products. In the dried chillies segment, the company procures chillies from agricultural market committee traders and carries out processing activities such as cleaning, grading, and sorting before distribution. Revenue is generated through direct domestic sales within India as well as exports to overseas markets including China, Kuwait, the United States, Malaysia, and the United Kingdom. The company utilizes processing facilities situated in Andhra Pradesh to manage its production operations across both product categories.
strengths: Integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities.
Established customer relationships and presence in key international markets.
Strategically located processing facilities in Andhra Pradesh with a strong sourcing network.
Consistent financial growth with improving operating margins over recent fiscal years.
Experienced promoter group and management team with deep domain expertise.
risks: Significant revenue concentration from export sales to customers located in China.
Dependence on a limited number of large customers for a major portion of revenues.
Operations rely heavily on external borrowings to meet working capital requirements.
Absence of long-term supply contracts for raw material procurement of shrimp and chillies.
Exposure to biosecurity risks, disease outbreaks, and strict international quality standards.

ipos.name: Shah Investor's Home
ipos.about: Shah Investor’s Home is a financial services provider in India engaged primarily in stock broking across equity, commodity, derivatives, and currency segments. The company generates a major portion of its revenue from its broking segment, earning brokerage income based on traded value and order size. Alongside broking, it provides financial services including mutual fund distributorship, margin trading facility, and stock lending and borrowing. It also offers research services covering equity fundamentals, derivatives, commodities, and mutual funds to assist clients. The company earns revenue through brokerage fees, interest income from margin trading facilities, and fees and commission income from distributing third-party financial products. Catering mainly to retail investors, including resident and non-resident Indians, the company executes transactions through its head office, branch network, online trading platforms, and a network of authorized persons, with a primary market focus and business concentration in the state of Gujarat.
strengths: Established market presence with strong client concentration in Gujarat.
Diversified financial offerings including broking, MTF, and mutual funds.
Dedicated in-house research covering equities, commodities, and mutual funds.
Expanding network of authorized persons driving client acquisition.
Capital infusion will strengthen working capital and fund MTF book expansion.
risks: Over 64% of revenue depends on stock broking, primarily from Gujarat.
High working capital needs to maintain margin trading and daily settlements.
Credit and market risks from potential client defaults in margin trading.
Heavy reliance on stock exchanges and third-party trading software providers.
Past regulatory non-compliances and untraceable historical secretarial records.
objectsOfIssue: Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (70 (77.63%))

ipos.name: SRIT India
ipos.about: SRIT India is an Information Technology and Information Technology-enabled Services solutions company offering digital solutions and system automation through custom application development and integration services. The company executes large-scale, mission-critical projects primarily for central and state government bodies, alongside enterprise clients across India and international markets. Its core operations are organized into three primary verticals: electronic governance, healthcare, and telecommunications and broadband. Revenue is predominantly generated by participating in competitive bidding processes to secure tender-driven contracts from government entities, which account for a substantial majority of its business. The company’s business model involves executing turnkey projects, often partnering with third-party technology companies to deliver bundled, integrated solutions and utilizing sub-contractors for specialized tasks. Furthermore, it provides customized solutions tailored to the specific needs and regulatory environments of each industry it serves.
strengths: Established relationships with key government and enterprise clients.
Proven track record of executing large-scale, turnkey digital projects.
Specialized IT solutions for e-governance, healthcare, and telecom.
Integration of emerging technologies like AI, IoT, and cloud services.
Strategic partnerships for delivering bundled technology solutions.
risks: Highly dependent on competitive government tenders for revenue.
Top ten customers account for a substantial majority of revenue.
Working capital-intensive operations pose liquidity constraints.
Heavy reliance on third-party sub-contractors and OEMs.
Order Book projects are subject to cancellations, modifications, or delays.
objectsOfIssue: Funding capital expenditure for modernization and redevelopment (12.869 (5.89%))
Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (124 (56.78%))

ipos.name: Shree TNB Polymers
ipos.about: Shree TNB Polymers operates in the polymer manufacturing sector, producing a range of plastic products across its three primary divisions: the Piping Division, the Solid Industrial Sheets Division, and the Corrugated/Flute Board Sheets Division. The company’s core business involves manufacturing and distributing these items under distinct brand names, specifically Noble, Tirupati, and Balaji (Wellpack). Its manufacturing operations are centralized in two facilities located in Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli. The company generates revenue through the sale of its manufactured products to various customer segments, including business houses, other manufacturing facilities, government entities, and end consumers. These sales are facilitated through direct channels as well as an established network of over 325 dealers and distributors across multiple states. Its product offerings cater to diverse industrial and consumer needs, relying on raw materials to maintain its manufacturing output.
strengths: Diverse product portfolio across piping, corrugated, and solid industrial sheets.
Established network of over 325 dealers across key commercial hubs.
Strategically located manufacturing facilities near major industrial areas.
Proven track record of consistent revenue generation across multiple brand divisions.
Expanding market footprint across diverse regional markets and states.
risks: High dependence on top ten customers for significant portions of revenue.
Business operations rely on leased manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
Potential under-utilization of newly expanded manufacturing capacities.
Volatility in the supply and pricing of raw materials impacting profit margins.
Subject to strict regional regulations and potential penalties for delayed compliance.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for purchase of machinery (15.86 (50.83%))
Capital expenditure for solar panel/roof top (2.6 (8.33%))

ipos.name: Pind Hospitality
ipos.about: Pind Hospitality operates in the consumer food services industry, managing food delivery services and dine-in restaurants under the recognized Pind Punjab brand. The business primarily functions on a hybrid model, generating a substantial portion of its revenue through third-party food delivery applications, which accounted for over 78% of its operations in recent years. Pind Hospitality strategically focuses on the Pune geographic market, where all its current operational revenues are concentrated. Following the acquisition of a significant stake in a related partnership firm, the business is consolidating its restaurant operations to streamline its footprint. Furthermore, Pind Hospitality is diversifying its service offerings by expanding into the hospitality and event sector. It is currently developing the Haveli Project in Lonavala, Maharashtra, a hotel-cum-banquet hall designed to cater to the destination wedding market and corporate conferences, thereby broadening its core revenue streams.
strengths: Recognized Pind Punjab brand with a strong customer base in Pune.
Successful hybrid operational model spanning online delivery and dine-in.
High volume of revenue driven consistently through food delivery apps.
Strategic expansion into destination weddings via the Lonavala Haveli Project.
Strong track record of profitability and positive operating cash flows.
risks: High dependence on third-party food delivery apps for the majority of revenues.
Entire operational revenue is highly concentrated within the Pune market.
Promoters lack prior operational experience in the hotel and banquet sector.
Vulnerability to lease non-renewals and rent increases for restaurant locations.
Pending tax litigation and past delays in statutory compliance filings.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for setting up Haveli Project in Lonavala (12.7 (71.27%))

ipos.name: Shivchem Agro
ipos.about: Shivchem Agro manufactures and distributes a wide range of agrochemicals and fertilizers designed for crop protection and yield enhancement. The company’s portfolio includes insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides, and various fertilizers. Operating from a manufacturing facility located in Jhajjar, Haryana, the business formulates chemical solutions to address diverse farming requirements. Shivchem Agro generates its revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of these agrochemical formulations across domestic markets, including Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Haryana, Telangana, Odisha, and Bihar. The company sells its offerings through an extensive distribution network, supported by strategically leased godowns across multiple Indian states to facilitate product supply and timely delivery. Raw materials are sourced from third-party suppliers on a purchase order basis to maintain continuous production. Shivchem Agro focuses on expanding its product portfolio, optimizing manufacturing capacity, and strengthening its regional market presence to effectively serve agricultural needs.
strengths: Portfolio of 176 agrochemicals and 82 fertilizers.
In-house manufacturing facility in Jhajjar, Haryana.
Network of 685 distributors across key domestic markets.
Strategically located 5 godowns ensuring efficient regional product supply.
Allocation of IPO funds for working capital expansion.
risks: Vulnerability to seasonal weather and monsoon variations.
Mandatory statutory approvals and regulatory compliances.
High working capital needs and history of negative cash flows.
Raw material price fluctuations without long-term contracts.
Operations conducted on leased plant and warehouse properties.
objectsOfIssue: Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (6.9 (49.25%))

ipos.name: Acme Universal Safezone 9
ipos.about: Acme Universal Safezone 9 manufactures industrial safety footwear, offering durable products that adhere to industry standards, including IS 15298 and IS 1989:2020. The company generates revenue by supplying safety shoes across various sectors, relying heavily on the defence and government sectors, alongside domestic business-to-business customers through open-market procurement and government rate contracts. The core business activities involve producing safety footwear using key raw materials such as polyurethane, PVC sole compounds, genuine leather, synthetic leather, and steel toe-caps. Acme operates manufacturing facilities in Gwalior, Banthar, and Banmore, having recently consolidated its Kanpur operations into the Banthar facility to improve process efficiency. The company emphasizes manufacturing durable safety shoes through efficient processes, utilizing advanced machinery like knife cutting machines and foam pouring machines. The business maintains a diversified customer base while focusing on consistent quality and competitive pricing for retail and institutional buyers.
strengths: Experienced management team with deep industry expertise.
Strict adherence to IS 15298 and IS 1989:2020 quality standards.
Efficient manufacturing powered by advanced machinery.
Cost-competitive offerings driven by efficient sourcing.
Diversified customer base across multiple industrial sectors.
risks: Top 10 customers account for 47.71% of total sales.
High revenue dependency on the defence and government sectors.
Vulnerable to price volatility for key materials like PU and PVC.
Manufacturing involves hazards like chemical exposure and heavy machinery.
Past delays in statutory dues expose the company to potential penalties.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for the installation of solar power plants (3.62 (10.08%))
Capital expenditure towards installation of additional machinery (8.96 (24.94%))
Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (8 (22.27%))

ipos.name: EverestIMS Technologies
ipos.about: EverestIMS Technologies is an information technology company providing software products and services focused on IT operations and service management. The company delivers solutions across IT service management, IT infrastructure management, network configuration and content management, artificial intelligence for IT operations, IT asset management, and operations support systems. EverestIMS Technologies offers its customers multiple consumption models, providing both software as a service (SaaS) and on-premises software solutions to meet varying operational requirements. Its business involves integrating third-party open-source databases, operating systems, queuing engines, and development tools into customer deliverables. The company derives its revenue primarily from the sale of software products, software services, and hardware products to its client base, which includes large corporate customers. Additionally, the company serves clients overseas in countries such as the United Arab Emirates and Malaysia, alongside its domestic operations.
strengths: Offers multiple SaaS and on-premises software models.
Serves diverse overseas clients in the UAE and Malaysia.
Holds long-standing relationships with key corporate customers.
Adopts advanced technologies via a dedicated AI Laboratory.
Shows strong and consistent financial and revenue growth
risks: High revenue dependence on the top 10 corporate customers.
Absence of formal agreements with some channel partners.
Past negative cash flows from investing and financing.
Software defects may cause liability and customer loss.
Open-source integration exposes the company to IP infringement claims.
objectsOfIssue: Purchase of IT hardware for AI Innovation Lab (5.66 (14.49%))

ipos.name: Black Opal Consultants
ipos.about: Black Opal Consultants operates as a financial and real estate consultancy firm providing integrated real estate solutions. The company generates revenue primarily through brokerage income from selling residential and commercial properties under exclusive sales mandates with real estate developers. Additionally, it earns revenue from loan syndication fees, advisory services, and real estate project development activities. Its core business activities include acting as a channel partner for property sales, offering real estate advisory, and facilitating property financing. The company’s operations are geographically concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana, specifically in Noida, Greater Noida, and Gurugram. It is also diversifying into real estate development, including a commercial hotel project named Veda in Ayodhya through its subsidiary entity, Aurika Developers. Furthermore, the company engages in inventory underwriting for real estate developers and is developing a digital property platform called JustHomz through its wholly owned subsidiary, Black Opal Technologies.
strengths: Integrated advisory, sales, and loan syndication services.
Established channel network in the Delhi-NCR market.
Strategic expansion into Ayodhya commercial real estate.
Tech-driven approach via the JustHomz digital platform.
Highly experienced promoters and management team.
risks: High revenue reliance on a few clients lacking long-term contracts.
Operations highly concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana.
Entering real estate development without a prior track record.
IPO funds for underwriting lack a specifically identified inventory.
Pending UP RERA real estate agent registration renewal.
objectsOfIssue: Funding for securing sales and marketing mandates (7 (15.88%))
Investment in Aurika Developers LLP for Ayodhya project development (26 (58.97%))

ipos.name: Papadmalji Agro Foods
ipos.about: Papadmalji Agro Foods engages in the manufacturing of handmade papads, machine-made papads, rice papads, vrat special papads, and moongodi, along with the trading of cereal pellets. The company also carries out white-label manufacturing of handmade papads, producing goods that clients market under their respective brand names and tailored packaging. Revenue is primarily generated through product sales under its key core brands, including Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana, alongside direct-to-consumer sales under the Papadmalji brand. Products are distributed across multiple sales channels, such as general trade, modern trade, quick commerce, direct-to-consumer platforms, and sales to merchant exporters for selected Middle Eastern markets. Operations are based out of manufacturing units and facilities situated in Bikaner, Rajasthan. For handmade papad production, the business utilizes a decentralized operational system involving contractors and home-based women workers who perform hand rolling according to prescribed quality specifications before final inspection.
strengths: Established brand presence via Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana.
Multi-channel distribution across general and modern trade.
Scalable in-house and decentralized manufacturing model.
Diverse portfolio of papads, moongodi, and cereal pellets.
Promoters possess extensive food processing industry experience.
risks: Revenue is heavily concentrated in the papad product segment.
Significant dependency on a limited number of top customers.
Operations and core sales are geographically concentrated in Rajasthan.
Lacks long-term supply agreements for agricultural raw materials.
Core brands face pending logo registrations and trademark oppositions.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for setting up a new manufacturing facility at Bikaner (7.9 (42.66%))
